player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Playroom, Craft room, Pantry, Recreation room, and back to Playroom, repeatedly visiting the same rooms without tracking which ones I had already seen. I failed to recognize that I had returned to the starting Gallery room without explicitly marking it as visited before stopping. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will immediately check if it is already in my list; if it is, I will choose a different available direction to explore new areas. I will only say "DONE" when I have visited every unique room available in the current path and no new directions lead to unvisited rooms. Specifically, when I returned to the Gallery, I should have realized I had completed the circuit and stopped immediately, rather than continuing to move unnecessarily.
